original_test_intent: Validate the eight LP transceiver thermal channels represented by TEMP_LP1~8_TRX against the approved transceiver specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The link/platform owner defines LP and TRX, maps each exact sensor to a physical transceiver or on-board SerDes instance, port/lane and stable module/device identity, and supplies link-state-qualified thermal limits before passive collection.
manual_activity: The link/platform owner defines LP/TRX meaning, maps all eight channels to ports/lanes and stable module or device identities, distinguishes the TRX sensing point from LP chip temperature, approves limits and reviews evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative LP and TRX definitions and whether each endpoint is pluggable optics, copper module or on-board SerDes
Exact TEMP_LP1_TRX through TEMP_LP8_TRX naming syntax and fitted population
Per-index board coordinate, port/lane, link peer and module serial/PN or stable device identity
Sensing source: module DOM, ASIC/SerDes die, remote diode or board probe
Units, scale, tolerance, refresh, stale/unavailable and module-not-present semantics
Ranges/thresholds by module type, link speed/state, traffic, airflow and ambient condition
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent link/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve eight exact TRX names rather than querying a literal tilde token
Do not infer that LP index equals port number or reuse adjacent chip temperature
Bind each reading to stable module/device plus port/lane and sensing source
Collect link/traffic state passively without enabling, disabling or retraining links
Do not service modules, reload drivers, generate traffic, change cooling/thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on identity/population change, link fault, stale/invalid telemetry or thermal event
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, LP/TRX semantics and eight-name expansion
Verify transceiver/module/device/port/lane topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, eight exact TRX results and BMC Web
Compare value/state/freshness with passive link speed/state/error/traffic/airflow/SEL context
Perform no chip substitution, module service, link/driver/workload action, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define LP/TRX component class and approve eight transceiver identities
Approve port/lane/peer and sensor-source mapping distinct from chip sensors
Provide module/link-state-specific thermal limits and absence rules
Review all fitted TRX channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A family-aligned read-only start, but `TEMP_LP1~8_TRX` is not a proven exact sensor; it omits complete IB/Sensor List/Web evidence, truncates SDR and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve eight owner-approved exact TRX names and stable port/module identities, then collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web and passive link context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LP1–LP8 TRX channels, all source views and 3/3-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES EIGHT-TRANSCEIVER PORT/MODULE MAP AND SENSOR-ORIGIN CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an eight-row mapping from exact sensor to TRX type, port/lane, peer, module/device identity, sensing source and link-state-qualified limit, then reconcile complete management views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Separates transceiver identity and module presence from generic LP numbering and prevents adjacent chip readings from satisfying TRX coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: LP chip sensors and TRX sensors may share a board position but cover different heat sources and response dynamics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: DOM temperature, SerDes die temperature and a nearby board probe have different thresholds and lag; module replacement or link remapping can silently invalidate index-based evidence.

project_override_considerations: Unpopulated pluggable ports require explicit not-present expectations. For soldered SerDes, use stable ASIC/fabric identity rather than a nonexistent module serial; aliases require a uniqueness rule.
expected_evidence: Approved LP/TRX definition and exact eight-name/fitted-population list
Eight port/lane/peer/module-or-device identities and sensor-origin map
Units, scale, freshness and module/link-state-qualified thermal criteria
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact results
BMC Web, same-target proof and passive link state/speed/error/traffic/airflow/SEL context
No-module-service/no-link-reset/no-driver/no-workload/no-cooling/no-threshold/no-reset/no-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1893 consistently targets TEMP_LP1~8_TRX across source and DeepSeek fields. Missing LP/TRX identity and topology are project inputs, not contradictory source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive eight-channel TRX comparison is identifiable after the owner supplies component, port/module and criteria mappings under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds transceiver type, port/lane, stable module identity and sensing-origin controls and explicitly separates the adjacent LP chip family.
independent_technical_reasoning: A `TRX` temperature can originate from pluggable-module DOM, an on-board SerDes die or a nearby board diode. Those sources follow different replacement identities, link states and limits, so an LP index and temperature value alone cannot establish coverage or acceptance.
